description: Candidate one-DGX Spark DeepSeek V4.1 Flash text profile on antirez/ds4 with the 1017 checkpoint Q2 GGUF streamed from local SSD (341 GiB file, including 189 GiB of disk-only Engram tables; keep it on a fast SSD). Vision and DSpark are not supported on CUDA for V4.1; one resident session; physical Spark acceptance is still required.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 DS4 single Spark
